text.en: Design space of diffusion models is row 69 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Design space of diffusion models 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 69 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Design space of diffusion models with “Elucidating the design space of diffusion-based generative models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Design space of diffusion models 与论文《Elucidating the design space of diffusion-based generative models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Tero Karras, Samuli Laine”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 特罗·卡拉斯、Samuli Laine（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Tero Karras, Samuli Laine”。
